messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: License true-up schedule + pilot migration plan for developer tooling

Team —

We have three upstream renewals/true-ups hitting the July–Aug window: JetBrains floating licenses (annual), GitHub Enterprise (self-hosted to the cloud pilot), and Atlassian bundles for Confluence/Jira. Finance needs a consolidated forecast for July POs by EOD Monday so we can avoid any access gaps for engineering.

Quick asks to get a single action plan going:
- Karthik: confirm technical constraints and minimum viable scope for a GitHub Enterprise Cloud pilot (expected 30 power users). Any blockers for August migration?
- Ben: can you request updated commercial quotes and push for a modest multi-product discount across JetBrains + Atlassian? Use the attached seat audit.
- Marissa: please confirm renewal windows for our product teams and any seats slated to sunset (we had a few contractors leaving in June).
- Rishi: finance/PO lead — once we have quotes/approved discounts we need a single master PO or three separate POs? What’s faster?

Attachments: atlassian_seat_audit.csv (current allocation) — please review.

Goal: produce a single one-page procurement plan with timeline + costs for Finance by Monday 2027-06-21. I’ll consolidate and present to Legal if vendor T&Cs require redlines.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Head of Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: License true-up schedule + pilot migration plan for developer tooling

Neha —

Quick technical note on the GitHub pilot: we can run a limited GitHub Enterprise Cloud pilot for ~30 heavy contributors, but two constraints:
1) Integrations: our internal CI runners, LFS usage, and the private IP allowlist for hooks will need short-lived IPs or connector work. Expect 2–3 engineering days to validate the LFS/CI flow.
2) SSO: OIDC/SCIM is fine; we need to test group sync with our Okta staging tenant.

Proposed pilot scope (30 users | 4 weeks):
- Week 0: tenant provisioning + SCIM test (1 day)
- Week 1: migrate 2 high-commit repos, test LFS and actions (3 days)
- Week 2: user feedback + CI reliability checks (3 days)
- Week 3: decision window + roll-back checklist (1 day)

If procurement can secure a 6-month convert-to-paid discount on the first-year commitment, we’ll convert rapidly. If GitHub requires long lead time for IP allowlists it could push to mid-August.

I’ll attach the pilot plan workbook (github_enterprise_pilot_plan.xlsx) with expected assignees.

—Karthik
Director, Platform Engineering

Thanks everyone — consolidated plan below (final version to be dropped into the procurement ticket):

1) JetBrains
- Accept quote v3 with 10% loyalty discount; adjust seats for -12 contractors = net +38 seats.
- Legal to review T&Cs; Ben to request 7-day pricing hold.
- Target PO submission: 2027-06-21.
- Attachment: jetbrains_quote_v3.pdf

2) GitHub Enterprise (Pilot)
- Approve 30-user Cloud pilot (Karthik to run). Procurement to secure 6-month convert-to-paid discount; ask for 25% first-year credit if we convert within 3 months.
- Pilot workbook attached (github_enterprise_pilot_plan.xlsx).
- Target decision window: 2027-07-25.

3) Atlassian (Confluence/Jira)
- Ben to request updated bundle quote using the attached seat audit; ask Atlassian for monthly invoicing option while we true-up account.
- Target PO: align with JetBrains PO on 2027-06-21 if pricing holds.

Rishi — please confirm whether Finance prefers a single master PO (preferred for simpler vendor payments) or three vendor-specific POs (if that speeds procurement). If no objection I will proceed with a single master PO and separate GL allocations per vendor.

I’ll attach the procurement ticket after I consolidate. Thanks — tight timeline but doable if each owner moves today.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
